# Third-party notices

What this repository carries that it did not write, and the terms each part comes
under. The [Sustainable Use License](../LICENSE.md) covers the code this project
wrote; it does not relicense anything listed here.

## github-mark

The launcher's GitHub mark, from [Primer Octicons](https://github.com/primer/octicons):
`mark-github-24.svg`. Copyright GitHub, Inc., under the MIT licence. It is a
vector asset in `os/ios/AppIcon.xcassets`, so the launcher needs no network to
draw it.

## donate-mark

The `donate-heart` icon, from [Boxicons](https://github.com/atisawd/boxicons) by way of
[SVG Repo](https://www.svgrepo.com/svg/334622/donate-heart/), under CC BY 4.0. The
attribution that licence asks for is in [boxicons/LICENSE](boxicons/LICENSE).

## Anton

`assets/fonts/Anton-Regular.ttf` is the launcher's display face, under the SIL
Open Font License. Its notice sits beside the font in
[assets/fonts/OFL.txt](../assets/fonts/OFL.txt).

## SDL, fpattern and zlib

Bundled as source: [sdl2](sdl2) under the zlib licence, [fpattern](fpattern)
under the licence in [fpattern/LICENSE](fpattern/LICENSE), and zlib from the iOS
SDK under its own.

## Music

`assets/audio/` holds the music the launcher plays and needs no attribution.
